propositions: review-bot logs the webhook and rerun authentication token in plaintext in uvicorn access logs via query string parameter, exposing a Gerrit credential to journald and any process that reads the journal
the exposure is fail-open with no error or alarm signal, and the secret cannot be rotated without the fix because any new token is logged immediately upon first use
the token must be moved from the query string to an HTTP header (X-Rebar-Token) and/or scrubbed from access logs via a redaction filter to prevent future exposure
the Gerrit webhooks configuration must be updated to send the token as an HTTP header instead of a URL parameter
the currently-logged token has been rotated and the rotation has been explicitly tracked and attested
the access log must continue to record request routes and response status codes for observability and debugging, while redacting only the credential value
